verdict.rationale: USCIS offers sanctioned headless, keyed APIs on the Torch developer platform: a Case Status API and a FOIA request/status API, with a sandbox and production keys. This allows status polling and FOIA submission to be automated without a browser. However, the core service of online filing has no API and goes only through account-based myUSCIS. The public case-status web host also bot-walls keyless agents, so automation is limited to two narrow, gated rails (production keys require passing a demo). Missing for 10: a filing or submission API, headless access to case management (address changes, G-28 filing), documented CI/CLI or scripted-workflow guidance, ungated self-serve production access, and independent hands-on corroboration of the APIs.
